select clazz.*,emp.name as masterName, ( CASE WHEN NOW() > clazz.end_date THEN '已结课' WHEN NOW() < clazz.begin_date THEN '未开班' ELSE '在读中' END ) AS status from clazz left join emp on clazz.master_id=emp.id
and clazz.name like concat('%',#{name},'%')
and end_date between #{begin} and #{end}
order by update_time desc
